description: This Java class is a Spring MVC controller named ShippingOptionsController responsible for handling administrative shipping options management in a web application. It provides endpoints to display and save shipping configuration settings, interacts with services and utilities, and manages model attributes for views.

classes.name: ShippingOptionsController
classes.description: Spring MVC controller for managing shipping options in the admin panel.

methods.name: displayShippingOptions
methods.description: Handles GET requests to display current shipping configuration, populates the model with shipping details.

methods.name: saveShippingOptions
methods.description: Handles POST requests to save modifications to shipping configuration, validates input, and updates the configuration.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Utility method to set the active menu items in the model for UI navigation.
